fuel_efficiency.description: The fuel efficiency of the vehicle in kilometers per liter

passenger_count.description: The number of passengers in the vehicle

description:
The recent field test was conducted using an SUV, covering a total distance of **350.5 km**. During the run the vehicle demonstrated a fuel efficiency of **12.3 km per litre**, which is consistent with the specifications provided for this model.

The test crew consisted of **5 passengers**, all of whom were seated throughout the journey. The data collected will be used to refine our consumption forecasts and to assess the suitability of the SUV for future multi‑passenger transport projects.
